section ‹Formalization of multiset narrowing and multiset reduction for E-unification and reachability problems›

theory Multiset_Narrowing
  imports
    Equational_Narrowing_Unification
begin

definition multiset_singleton_ext :: "'a rel ⇒ 'a multiset rel" where
  "multiset_singleton_ext R = {({#a#} + A, {#b#} + A) | a b A. (a, b) ∈ R}" 

lemma multiset_singleton_ext_mult1: "multiset_singleton_ext R ⊆ (mult1 (R^-1))^-1" 
  unfolding multiset_singleton_ext_def by clarify

lemma multiset_singleton_ext_mult: "multiset_singleton_ext R ⊆ (mult (R^-1))^-1"
  using multiset_singleton_ext_mult1[of R] 
  using mult_def r_into_trancl' by blast

lemma SN_mult: assumes "SN R" shows "SN ((mult (R^-1))^-1)" 
  using assms unfolding SN_iff_wf converse_converse using wf_mult by auto 

lemma SN_multiset_singleton_ext_mult: assumes "SN R" shows "SN (multiset_singleton_ext R)" 
  by (rule SN_subset[OF SN_mult[OF assms] multiset_singleton_ext_mult])

locale multiset_narrowing =  equational_narrowing R DOTEQ TOP R' F D x
  for R::"('f, 'v:: infinite) trs" 
    and DOTEQ :: 'f ("≐")
    and TOP :: "'f" ("⊤") 
    and R' :: "('f, 'v:: infinite) trs" 
    and F :: "'f sig" 
    and D :: "'f sig"
    and x :: 'v
begin

(* Multiset rewriting and multiset narrowing *)

inductive_set multiset_reduction_step where 
    "s ∈# S ∧ T = ((S - {#s#}) + {#t#}) ∧ (s, t) ∈ rstep R ⟹ (S, T) ∈ multiset_reduction_step"

inductive_set multiset_narrowing_step where
    "(s ∈# S ∧ T = (subst_term_multiset σ (S - {#s#}) + {#t#}) ∧ (s, t, σ) ∈ narrowing_step)
      ⟹ (S, T, σ) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step"

definition multiset_narrowing_rel where 
  "multiset_narrowing_rel = {(S, T) | S T σ. (S, T, σ) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step}"

lemmas multiset_reduction_stepI = multiset_reduction_step.intros [intro]
lemmas multiset_reduction_stepE = multiset_reduction_step.cases [elim]
lemmas multiset_narrowing_stepI = multiset_narrowing_step.intros [intro]
lemmas multiset_narrowing_stepE = multiset_narrowing_step.cases [elim]

lemma rm_correspondence:assumes sL:"s ∈# L"
  and st:"(s, t) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*"
shows "(L, L - {#s#} + {#t#}) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧*"
proof -
  from st obtain n where "(s, t) ∈ (rstep R)^^n" by auto
  then show ?thesis using sL
  proof(induct n arbitrary:t)
    case 0
    then show ?case by simp
  next
    case (Suc n)
    from Suc(2) obtain u where su:"(s, u) ∈ rstep R ^^ n" and ut:"(u, t) ∈  rstep R" by auto
    hence "(L, L - {#s#} + {#u#}) ∈ multiset_reduction_step⇧*" using Suc(1) sL by auto
    with ut show ?case
      by (metis (no_types, lifting) add_diff_cancel_right' multiset_reduction_stepI rtrancl.simps union_mset_add_mset_right union_single_eq_member)
  qed
qed

(* Acknowledgement: This lemma was formalized by René Thiemann *)
lemma SN_R_imp_SN_multiset_reduction_step: assumes "SN (rstep R)" 
  shows "SN multiset_reduction_step" 
proof (rule SN_subset[OF SN_multiset_singleton_ext_mult[OF assms]], clarify)
  fix a b 
  show "(a, b) ∈ multiset_reduction_step ⟹ (a, b) ∈ multiset_singleton_ext (rstep R)"
    apply (cases a b rule: multiset_reduction_step.cases)
    by (auto simp: multiset_singleton_ext_def) (metis insert_DiffM)
qed

lemma CR_correspondence:assumes cr:"CR (rstep R)"
  and snm:"SN (rstep R)"
shows "CR (multiset_reduction_step)"
proof (rule Newman[OF SN_R_imp_SN_multiset_reduction_step[OF snm]])
  from  cr have wcr:"WCR (rstep R)"
    by (meson CR_onD WCR_on_def r_into_rtrancl)
  then show "WCR (multiset_reduction_step)"
  proof -
    { fix L M N
      assume "(L, M) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step) ∧ (L, N) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)"
      hence LM:"(L, M) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)" and LN:"(L, N) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)" by auto
      from LM obtain s1 t1 where s1L:"s1 ∈# L" and M:"M = ((L - {#s1#}) + {#t1#})" and s1t1:"(s1, t1) ∈ rstep R" by auto
      from LN obtain s2 t2 where s2L:"s2 ∈# L" and N:"N = ((L - {#s2#}) + {#t2#})" and s2t2:"(s2, t2) ∈ rstep R" by auto
      hence "(M, N) ∈ join (multiset_reduction_step)" using cr
      proof(cases "s1 = s2")
        case True
        with s1t1 s2t2 have "(t1, t2) ∈ (rstep R)⇧↓" using cr by auto
        then obtain t3 where t1t3:"(t1, t3) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" and t2t3:"(t2, t3) ∈ (rstep R)⇧*" by auto
        from t1t3 rm_correspondence have Ms:"(M, M - {#t1#} + {#t3#}) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧*" 
          by (metis M add_implies_diff add_mset_add_single add_mset_remove_trivial_eq)
        from t2t3 rm_correspondence have Ns:"(N, N - {#t2#} + {#t3#}) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧*" 
          by (metis N add_implies_diff add_mset_add_single add_mset_remove_trivial_eq)
        have "M - {#t1#} + {#t3#} = N - {#t2#} + {#t3#}" using M N True by auto
        then show ?thesis using rm_correspondence using Ms Ns by auto
      next
        case False
        with M s2L s2t2 have Ms:"(M, M  - {#s2#} + {#t2#}) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)" 
          by (metis (no_types, lifting) False add_mset_add_single insert_DiffM insert_noteq_member multiset_reduction_stepI s1L union_iff)
        with N s1L s1t1 have Ns:"(N, N  - {#s1#} + {#t1#}) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)"
          by (metis (no_types, lifting) False add_mset_add_single insert_DiffM insert_noteq_member multiset_reduction_stepI s2L union_iff)
        have "M  - {#s2#} + {#t2#} = N  - {#s1#} + {#t1#}" using M N 
          by (auto, smt (verit) False add_eq_conv_diff add_mset_remove_trivial diff_union_swap insert_DiffM s1L s2L)
        then show ?thesis using Ms Ns by auto
      qed
    } then show ?thesis 
      by (simp add: WCR_on_def)
  qed
qed

inductive_set multiset_reduction_step_pos::"(('f, 'v) term multiset) rel"
  where 
    "(s ∈# S ∧ T = ((S - {#s#}) + {#replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ)#}) ∧ 
    rl ∈ R ∧  p ∈ poss s ∧ (s |_ p = (fst rl) ⋅ σ)) ⟹ (S, T) ∈ multiset_reduction_step_pos"

inductive_set multiset_narrowing_step_pos::"(('f, 'v) term multiset × ('f, 'v) term multiset × ('f, 'v) subst) set"
  where
    "(s ∈# S ∧ T = subst_term_multiset δ ((S - {#s#}) + {#replace_at s p (snd rl)#}) ∧  
         ω ∙ rl ∈ R ∧ (vars_term s ∩ vars_rule rl = {}) ∧ p ∈ fun_poss s ∧ mgu (s |_ p) (fst rl) = Some δ)
      ⟹ (S, T, δ) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step_pos"

lemmas multiset_reduction_step_posI = multiset_reduction_step_pos.intros [intro]
lemmas multiset_reduction_step_posE = multiset_reduction_step_pos.cases [elim]
lemmas multiset_narrowing_step_posI = multiset_narrowing_step_pos.intros [intro]
lemmas multiset_narrowing_step_posE = multiset_narrowing_step_pos.cases [elim]

lemma mul_reduction_correspondence [simp]:"(S, T) ∈ multiset_reduction_step ⟹ (S, T) ∈ multiset_reduction_step_pos" and
      "(S, T) ∈ multiset_reduction_step_pos ⟹ (S, T) ∈ multiset_reduction_step" 
proof -
  show "(S, T) ∈ multiset_reduction_step ⟹ (S, T) ∈ multiset_reduction_step_pos"
  proof -
    assume asm:"(S, T) ∈ multiset_reduction_step"
    then show "(S, T) ∈ multiset_reduction_step_pos"
    proof -
      from asm obtain s t where "s ∈# S ∧ T = ((S - {#s#}) + {#t#}) ∧ (s, t) ∈ rstep R" by auto
      hence "∃p rl σ. (s ∈# S ∧ T = ((S - {#s#}) + {#replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ)#}) ∧ 
        rl ∈ R ∧  p ∈ poss s ∧ (s |_ p = (fst rl) ⋅ σ))" 
        by (smt (verit) ctxt_of_pos_term_hole_pos fst_conv hole_pos_poss rstep.simps snd_conv subt_at_hole_pos)
      then show ?thesis by blast
    qed
  qed
  show "(S, T) ∈ multiset_reduction_step_pos ⟹ (S, T) ∈ multiset_reduction_step"
  proof -
    assume asm:"(S, T) ∈ multiset_reduction_step_pos"
    then show "(S, T) ∈ multiset_reduction_step"
    proof -
      from asm obtain s  rl p σ where "(s ∈# S ∧ T = ((S - {#s#}) + {#replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ)#}) ∧ 
        rl ∈ R ∧  p ∈ poss s ∧ (s |_ p = (fst rl) ⋅ σ))" by auto
      then show ?thesis by (metis multiset_reduction_stepI prod.exhaust_sel replace_at_ident rstepI)
    qed
  qed
qed

lemma mul_narrowing_correspondence [simp]:"(S, T, δ) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step ⟹ (S, T, δ) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step_pos" and
  "(S, T, δ) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step_pos ⟹ (S, T, δ) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step"
proof -
  show "(S, T, δ) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step ⟹ (S, T, δ) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step_pos"
  proof -
    assume asm:"(S, T, δ) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step"
    show "(S, T, δ) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step_pos"
    proof -
      from asm obtain  s t where s:"s ∈# S" and ST:"T = (subst_term_multiset δ (S - {#s#}) + {#t#})" and stδ:"(s, t, δ) ∈ narrowing_step" by auto
      from stδ obtain ω rl p where t:"t = (replace_at s p (snd rl)) ⋅ δ" and rl:"ω ∙ rl ∈ R" and srl:"(vars_term s ∩ vars_rule rl = {})"
        and p:"p ∈ fun_poss s" and mgu:"mgu (s |_ p) (fst rl) = Some δ" by auto
      have T:"T = subst_term_multiset δ ((S - {#s#}) + {#replace_at s p (snd rl)#})" 
        by (metis ST t add_mset_add_single image_mset_add_mset subst_term_multiset_def)
      show ?thesis using multiset_narrowing_step_pos.intros[of s S T δ p rl ω]
        using T mgu p rl s srl by auto
    qed
  qed
  show "(S, T, δ) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step_pos ⟹ (S, T, δ) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step"
  proof -
    assume asm:"(S, T, δ) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step_pos"
    show "(S, T, δ) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step"
    proof -
      from asm obtain s p rl  ω where *:"(s ∈# S ∧ T = subst_term_multiset δ ((S - {#s#}) + {#replace_at s p (snd rl)#}) ∧  
         ω ∙ rl ∈ R ∧ (vars_term s ∩ vars_rule rl = {}) ∧ p ∈ fun_poss s ∧ mgu (s |_ p) (fst rl) = Some δ)" by auto
      then show ?thesis unfolding subst_term_multiset_def 
        by (smt (verit)* add_mset_add_single image_mset_add_mset multiset_narrowing.multiset_narrowing_step.simps 
            multiset_narrowing_axioms narrowing_stepI subst_term_multiset_def)
    qed
  qed
qed

definition multiset_narrowing_step'::"(('f, 'v) term multiset) rel" where 
  "multiset_narrowing_step' = {(S, T) | S T σ. (S, T, σ) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step}"

definition multiset_narrowing_derivation :: "('f, 'v) term multiset ⇒ ('f, 'v) term multiset ⇒ ('f, 'v) subst ⇒ bool" where
  "multiset_narrowing_derivation S S' σ ⟷ (∃n. (S,  S') ∈ (multiset_narrowing_step')^^n ∧ (∃f τ. f 0 = S ∧ f n = S' ∧ 
  (∀i < n. ((f i), (f (Suc i)), (τ i)) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step) ∧ (if n = 0 then σ = Var else σ = compose (map (λi. (τ i)) [0 ..< n]))))"
term n
definition multiset_narrowing_derivation_num :: "('f, 'v) term multiset ⇒ ('f, 'v) term multiset ⇒ ('f, 'v) subst ⇒ nat ⇒ bool" where
  "multiset_narrowing_derivation_num S S' σ n ⟷ ((S,  S') ∈ (multiset_narrowing_step')^^n ∧ (∃f τ. f 0 = S ∧ f n = S' ∧ 
  (∀i < n. ((f i), (f (Suc i)), (τ i)) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step) ∧ (if n = 0 then σ = Var else σ = compose (map (λi. (τ i)) [0 ..< n]))))"

lemma n0_multiset_narrowing_derivation_num:"multiset_narrowing_derivation_num S S' σ 0 ⟹ S = S' ∧ σ = Var" 
  unfolding multiset_narrowing_derivation_num_def by auto

lemma multiset_narrowing_deriv_implication: assumes "multiset_narrowing_derivation_num S S' σ n"
  shows "multiset_narrowing_derivation S S' σ" 
  unfolding multiset_narrowing_derivation_num_def multiset_narrowing_derivation_def
  using assms multiset_narrowing_derivation_num_def by metis

lemma multiset_narrowing_set_imp_rtran: assumes "(S, T, σ) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step"
  shows "multiset_narrowing_derivation_num S T σ 1"
proof -
  have *:"(S, T) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step'" using assms 
    using multiset_narrowing_step'_def by auto
  then obtain f where f0:"f 0 = S" and f1:"f 1 = T" and rel_chain:"(f 0,  f (Suc 0)) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step'" 
    by (metis One_nat_def relpow_0_I relpow_Suc_I relpow_fun_conv)
  let ?τ = "λi. (if i = 0 then σ else Var)"
  show ?thesis  unfolding multiset_narrowing_derivation_num_def
  proof(intro conjI, goal_cases)
    case 1
    then show ?case by (simp add: *)
  next
    case 2
    then show ?case by (rule exI[of _ f], rule exI[of _ ?τ], insert assms f0 f1, auto)
  qed
qed

lemma subst_term_multiset_perm_conv_main: fixes xs::"('f, 'v)rule list"
  shows "{#t ⋅ sop ω. t ∈# {#Fun ≐ [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset xs#}#} = 
    {#Fun ≐ [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset (ω ∙ xs) #}"
proof -
  have "{#t ⋅ sop ω. t ∈# {#Fun ≐ [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset xs#}#} = 
          {# (Fun ≐ [u, v]) ⋅ sop ω. (u, v) ∈# mset xs #}"
  proof(auto split:prod.splits, induct xs)
    case Nil
    then show ?case by simp
  next
    case (Cons a xs)
    then show ?case by (auto split:prod.splits)
  qed
  also have "... = {#Fun ≐ [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset (ω ∙ xs) #}"
  proof(auto split:prod.splits, induct xs)
    case Nil
    then show ?case by simp
  next
    case (Cons a xs)
    then show ?case by (auto split:prod.splits simp add: rule_pt.permute_prod.simps ) 
  qed
  finally show ?thesis by auto
qed

lemma subst_term_multiset_perm_conv_pre: fixes xs::"('f, 'v)rule list"
  shows "{# (t ⋅ θ). t ∈# {# Fun (≐) [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset (xs) #}#} = 
  {# (t ⋅ (sop ω ∘⇩s θ)). t ∈# {# Fun (≐) [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset (- ω ∙ xs) #} #}"
proof -
  let ?M = "{# Fun (≐) [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset xs #}"
  let ?Q = "{# Fun (≐) [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset (- ω ∙ xs) #}"
  have "?Q = subst_term_multiset (sop (- ω)) ?M"
  proof -
    have "{#Fun ≐ [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset (- ω ∙ xs) #} = {#t ⋅ sop (- ω). t ∈# {#Fun ≐ [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset xs#}#}" 
      using subst_term_multiset_perm_conv_main by metis 
    then show ?thesis 
      by (simp add: subst_term_multiset_def)
  qed
  then show ?thesis
    by (smt (verit) comp_apply multiset.map_comp multiset.map_cong0 subst_subst_compose 
        subst_term_multiset_def term_apply_subst_Var_Rep_perm term_pt.permute_minus_cancel(1))
qed

lemma subst_compose_o_assoc:
  "(σ ∘⇩s τ) ∘ f = (σ ∘ f) ∘⇩s τ"
  by (rule ext) (simp add: subst_compose)

lemma subst_term_multiset_perm_conv: fixes xs::"('f, 'v)rule list"
  assumes "θ = sop ω ∘⇩s σ"
  shows "subst_term_multiset σ {# Fun (≐) [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset (ω ∙ xs) #} = subst_term_multiset θ {# Fun (≐) [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset xs #}"
proof -
  have σ:"σ = sop (- ω) ∘⇩s θ" using assms  
    by (metis permute_subst_subst_compose subst_compose_o_assoc subst_monoid_mult.mult.left_neutral subst_pt.permute_minus_cancel(2))
  have "subst_term_multiset σ {# Fun (≐) [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset (ω ∙ xs) #} = {# (t ⋅ σ). t ∈# {# Fun (≐) [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset (ω ∙ xs) #} #}"
    unfolding subst_term_multiset_def by auto
  also have "... = {# (t ⋅ sop (- ω) ∘⇩s θ). t ∈# {# Fun (≐) [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset (ω ∙ xs) #} #}" using σ by force
  also have "... = {# (t ⋅ sop ω ∘⇩s sop (- ω) ∘⇩s θ). t ∈# {# Fun (≐) [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset (- ω ∙ ω ∙ xs) #} #}" 
    using σ subst_term_multiset_perm_conv_pre 
    by (metis subst_compose_assoc)
  also have "... = {# (t ⋅  θ). t ∈# {# Fun (≐) [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset (- ω ∙ ω ∙ xs) #} #}" by auto
  finally show ?thesis by (simp add: subst_term_multiset_def)
qed

lemma subst_subtract_term_multiset: assumes "subst_domain σ ⊆ vars_term_set (set_mset S)"
  and "u ∈# S"
shows "subst_term_multiset σ (S - {#u#}) = subst_term_multiset σ S - subst_term_multiset σ {#u#}" 
proof -
  have "subst_term_multiset σ (S - {#u#}) ⊆# subst_term_multiset σ S - subst_term_multiset σ {#u#}"
    unfolding subst_term_multiset_def using assms 
    by (simp add: image_mset_Diff)
  moreover have "subst_term_multiset σ S - subst_term_multiset σ {#u#} ⊆# subst_term_multiset σ (S - {#u#})"
    unfolding subst_term_set_def using assms
    by (simp add: image_mset_Diff subst_term_multiset_def)
  ultimately show ?thesis by simp
qed

lemma subst_term_multiset_union: "subst_term_multiset σ (M + N) = subst_term_multiset σ M + subst_term_multiset σ N" 
  unfolding subst_term_multiset_def by simp

lemma multiset_nar_vars_finite: assumes "multiset_narrowing_derivation_num S S' σ n"
  and "finite (vars_term_set (set_mset S))"
shows "finite (vars_term_set (set_mset S'))" using assms
proof( induct n arbitrary: S' σ)
  case 0
  then show ?case 
    using n0_multiset_narrowing_derivation_num by auto
next
  case (Suc n)
  from Suc have "multiset_narrowing_derivation_num S S' σ (Suc n)" by auto
  hence SS':"(S,  S') ∈ (multiset_narrowing_step')^^(Suc n)" and relchain':"(∃f τ. f 0 = S ∧ f (Suc n) = S' ∧ 
    (∀i < (Suc n). ((f i), (f (Suc i)), (τ i)) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step) ∧ (σ = compose (map (λi. (τ i)) [0 ..< (Suc n)])))"
    unfolding multiset_narrowing_derivation_num_def by auto
  from relchain' obtain f τ where f0:"f 0 = S" and fsucn:"f (Suc n) = S'" and 
    relchain:"∀i < (Suc n). ((f i), (f (Suc i)), (τ i)) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step" 
    and σ:"(σ = compose (map (λi. (τ i)) [0 ..< (Suc n)]))" by auto
  let ?τ = "compose (map (λi. (τ i)) [0 ..< n])"
  let ?σ = "if n = 0 then Var else ?τ"
  let ?f = "λi. (if i ≤ n then f i else undefined)"
  from relchain obtain U where U:"f n = U" by simp
  from relchain have nchain:"∀i < n. ((f i), (f (Suc i)), (τ i)) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step" by simp
  hence f0fn:"(f 0, f n) ∈ (multiset_narrowing_step')^^n" unfolding multiset_narrowing_step'_def 
    by (smt (verit, del_insts) mem_Collect_eq relpow_fun_conv)
  have "(S,  U) ∈ (multiset_narrowing_step')^^n" using f0 U f0fn by auto
  moreover have "(∃f τ. f 0 = S ∧ f n = U ∧ (∀i < n. ((f i), (f (Suc i)), (τ i)) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step))"
    by (rule exI[of _ "?f"] rule exI[of _ "?σ"], insert U f0 nchain, auto)
  moreover have "multiset_narrowing_derivation_num S U ?σ n" unfolding multiset_narrowing_derivation_num_def
    using U calculation f0 nchain by auto 
  ultimately have finiteU:"finite (vars_term_set (set_mset U))" using Suc by auto
  have "∃δ. (U, S', δ) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step" using relchain fsucn U by auto
  then obtain δ where "(U, S', δ) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step" by auto
  then obtain s rl ω p where "s ∈# U" and S'eq:"S' = subst_term_multiset δ ((U - {#s#}) + {#replace_at s p (snd rl)#})"
    and "ω ∙ rl ∈ R" and "(vars_term s ∩ vars_rule rl = {})" and "p ∈ fun_poss s" and  mgu:"mgu (s |_ p) (fst rl) = Some δ" 
    using mul_narrowing_correspondence by blast
  from S'eq have *:"S' = subst_term_multiset δ (U - {#s#}) + subst_term_multiset δ {#replace_at s p (snd rl)#}" (is "S' = ?A + ?B")
    by (metis subst_term_multiset_union)
  have "vars_term_set (set_mset S') = vars_term_set (set_mset ?A) ∪ vars_term_set (set_mset ?B)"
    unfolding vars_term_set_def using "*" by auto
  moreover have "finite (vars_term_set (set_mset ?A))" 
    unfolding vars_term_set_def using finiteU mgu_finite_range_vars[OF mgu] finite_vars_term by blast
  moreover have "finite (vars_term_set (set_mset ?B))" unfolding vars_term_set_def by simp
  ultimately show ?case using * by auto
qed

lemma wf_eq_mset_subst_inv: fixes θ:: "('f, 'v) subst"
  assumes "wf_equational_term_mset M"
  shows "wf_equational_term_mset (subst_term_multiset θ M)" 
proof -
  let ?M = "subst_term_multiset θ M"
  from assms have "(∀t ∈# M. wf_equational_term t)" unfolding wf_equational_term_mset_def by simp
  moreover have "?M = {# (t ⋅ θ). t ∈# M #}" unfolding subst_term_multiset_def by auto
  moreover have "∀s ∈# M. wf_equational_term s" by (simp add: calculation)
  then show ?thesis unfolding subst_term_multiset_def wf_equational_term_mset_def 
    using wf_eq_subst by auto
qed

lemma wf_equational_term_mset_add: assumes "wf_equational_term_mset A" and "wf_equational_term_mset B"
  shows "wf_equational_term_mset (A + B)" using assms
  using wf_equational_term_mset_def by (metis union_iff)

lemma root_not_special_symbols: assumes "rl ∈ R'"
  and "funas_rule rl ⊆ F"
  and rnone:"root (fst rl) ≠ None"
shows "root (fst rl) ≠ Some (≐, 2) ∧ root (fst rl) ≠ Some (⊤, 0)" 
  using assms root_special_notin_F unfolding  D D_fresh R_sig 
    funas_rule_def funas_trs_def by auto 

lemma vars_cond_perm:"vars_trs (trs) ⊆ vars_term t ⟹ vars_trs (ω ∙ trs) ⊆ vars_term (ω ∙ t)"
  unfolding vars_trs_def vars_rule_def by auto (smt (verit, ccfv_threshold) SUP_le_iff atom_set_pt.subset_eqvt 
      fst_conv le_supE rule_pt.fst_eqvt subsetD term_pt.permute_minus_cancel(1) trs_pt.eq_eqvt trs_pt.inv_mem_simps(1) 
      vars_term_eqvt, smt (verit, ccfv_threshold) SUP_le_iff atom_set_pt.subset_eqvt le_supE rule_pt.snd_eqvt 
      snd_conv subsetD term_pt.permute_minus_cancel(1) trs_pt.eq_eqvt trs_pt.inv_mem_simps(1) vars_term_eqvt)

lemma multiset_narrowing_based_reachable_single: 
  assumes nar:"(S, T, σ) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step"
  shows "(subst_term_multiset σ S, T) ∈ multiset_reduction_step"
proof -
  from nar obtain s p rl ω where s:"s ∈# S" and T:"T = subst_term_multiset σ ((S - {#s#}) + {#replace_at s p (snd rl)#})" and 
    rl:"ω ∙ rl ∈ R" and varcond:"(vars_term s ∩ vars_rule rl = {})" and p:"p ∈ fun_poss s" and mgu:"mgu (s |_ p) (fst rl) = Some σ"
    using mul_narrowing_correspondence by blast
  let ?S = "subst_term_multiset σ S"
  let ?s = "s ⋅ σ"
  let ?T = "(?S - {#?s#}) + {#replace_at ?s p (snd rl ⋅ (((sop ω) ∘⇩s σ)))#}"
  have perm_fst_rl:"fst (ω ∙ rl) ⋅ ((sop (- ω)) ∘⇩s σ) = fst rl ⋅ σ" by (simp add: rule_pt.fst_eqvt)
  have perm_snd_rl:"snd (ω ∙ rl) ⋅ ((sop (- ω)) ∘⇩s σ) = snd rl ⋅ σ" by (simp add: rule_pt.snd_eqvt)
  from mgu have sp:"(s |_ p) ⋅ σ = (fst rl) ⋅ σ" using mgu subst_apply_term_eq_subst_apply_term_if_mgu by auto
  have sS:"?s ∈# ?S" unfolding subst_term_multiset_def using s by auto
  have T_new:"T = ?S - {#?s#} + {#replace_at ?s p (snd (ω ∙ rl) ⋅ (sop (- ω) ∘⇩s σ))#}" using T  perm_snd_rl 
    by (smt (verit) add_mset_add_single add_mset_remove_trivial ctxt_of_pos_term_subst fun_poss_imp_poss 
        image_mset_add_mset insert_DiffM p s subst_apply_term_ctxt_apply_distrib subst_term_multiset_def)
  have pfun:"p ∈ fun_poss ?s" using p by (metis (no_types, opaque_lifting) fun_poss_fun_conv fun_poss_imp_poss 
    funas_term.cases is_FunI poss_imp_subst_poss poss_is_Fun_fun_poss subst_apply_eq_Var subt_at_subst term.distinct(1))
  have "(s |_ p) ⋅ σ = (?s |_ p)" using p pfun by (simp add: fun_poss_imp_poss)
  hence *:"?s |_ p = (fst (ω ∙ rl)) ⋅ (sop (- ω) ∘⇩s σ)" using sp perm_fst_rl by auto
  have "(subst_term_multiset σ S, T) ∈ multiset_reduction_step_pos"
  proof(rule multiset_reduction_step_pos.intros, intro conjI)
    show "?s ∈# subst_term_multiset σ S" using sS by auto
    show "T = subst_term_multiset σ S - {#s ⋅ σ#} + {#(ctxt_of_pos_term p (s ⋅ σ))⟨snd (ω ∙ rl) ⋅ (sop (- ω) ∘⇩s σ)⟩#}"
      using T_new by auto 
    show "ω ∙ rl ∈ R" using rl by auto
    show "p ∈ poss (s ⋅ σ)" using pfun 
      by (simp add: fun_poss_imp_poss)
    show "s ⋅ σ |_ p = fst (ω ∙ rl) ⋅ sop (- ω) ∘⇩s σ" by (simp add: *)
  qed
  then show ?thesis 
    by (smt (verit, ccfv_SIG) multiset_narrowing.multiset_reduction_step.simps multiset_narrowing.multiset_reduction_step_posE 
        multiset_narrowing_axioms prod.exhaust_sel replace_at_ident rstepI)
qed

lemma subst_closed_multiset_reduction: assumes st:"(S, T) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧*"
  shows "(subst_term_multiset σ S, subst_term_multiset σ T) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧*"
proof -
  from st obtain n where "(S, T) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)^^n" by auto
  then show ?thesis
  proof(induct n arbitrary: T)
    case 0
    then show ?case by auto
  next
    case (Suc n)
    from Suc(2) obtain U where SU:"(S, U) ∈ multiset_reduction_step ^^ n" and UT:"(U, T) ∈ multiset_reduction_step" by auto
    have "(subst_term_multiset σ S, subst_term_multiset σ U) ∈ multiset_reduction_step⇧*" using Suc SU by auto
    moreover
    { 
      from UT obtain s p rl θ where sU:"s ∈# U" and T:"T = ((U - {#s#}) + {#replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ θ)#})" and 
        rl:"rl ∈ R" and p:"p ∈ poss s" and sp:"(s |_ p = (fst rl) ⋅ θ)" using mul_reduction_correspondence by blast
      let ?U = "subst_term_multiset σ U"
      let ?T = "subst_term_multiset σ T"
      let ?s = "s ⋅ σ"
      have pfun:"p ∈ fun_poss ?s" using p
        by (metis Un_iff fun_root_not_None is_VarE local.wf poss_imp_subst_poss poss_simps(2) prod.collapse rl 
            root.simps(1) root_subst_inv sp subt_at_subst var_poss_iff weak_match.simps(2) weak_match_match wf_trs_imp_lhs_Fun)
      have T_new:"?T = ((?U - {#?s#}) + {#replace_at ?s p (((snd rl) ⋅ θ) ⋅ σ)#})" unfolding subst_term_multiset_def using T
        by (simp add: sU ctxt_of_pos_term_subst fun_poss_imp_poss image_mset_Diff p)
      have *:"(?s |_ p = ((fst rl) ⋅ θ) ⋅ σ)" using sp pfun by (simp add: fun_poss_imp_poss p)
      have "(subst_term_multiset σ U, subst_term_multiset σ T) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step_pos)"
      proof(rule multiset_reduction_step_pos.intros, intro conjI)
        show "?s ∈# subst_term_multiset σ U" 
          by (simp add: sU subst_term_multiset_def)
        show "subst_term_multiset σ T = subst_term_multiset σ U - {#s ⋅ σ#} + {#replace_at ?s p ((snd rl) ⋅ (θ ∘⇩s σ))#}" 
          using T_new by auto
        show "rl ∈ R" using rl by auto
        show "p ∈ poss (s ⋅ σ)" using p by auto
        show "s ⋅ σ |_ p = fst rl ⋅ θ ∘⇩s σ" by (simp add: *)
      qed
    }
    ultimately show ?case by (smt (verit, ccfv_SIG) multiset_narrowing.multiset_reduction_step.simps 
      multiset_narrowing.multiset_reduction_step_pos.simps multiset_narrowing_axioms prod.exhaust_sel 
      replace_at_ident rstepI rtrancl.rtrancl_into_rtrancl)
  qed
qed

lemma multiset_narrowing_reduction: 
  assumes nd:"multiset_narrowing_derivation S S' σ"
  shows "(subst_term_multiset σ S, S') ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧*" 
proof -
  from nd obtain n where "multiset_narrowing_derivation_num S S' σ n" unfolding multiset_narrowing_derivation_def 
      multiset_narrowing_derivation_num_def by auto
  then show ?thesis
  proof(induct n arbitrary: S' σ)
    case 0
    then show ?case using n0_multiset_narrowing_derivation_num unfolding subst_term_multiset_def
      by (metis multiset.map_ident_strong rtrancl.simps subst.cop_nil)
  next
    case (Suc n)
    from ‹multiset_narrowing_derivation_num S S' σ (Suc n)›
    have "(∃f τ. f 0 = S ∧ f (Suc n) = S' ∧ 
      (∀i < (Suc n). ((f i), (f (Suc i)), (τ i)) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step) ∧ (σ = compose (map (λi. (τ i)) [0 ..< Suc n])))"
      unfolding multiset_narrowing_derivation_num_def by auto
    then obtain f τ where f0:"f 0 = S" and fsucn:"f (Suc n) = S'" and 
      relchain:"∀i < (Suc n). ((f i), (f (Suc i)), (τ i)) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step" 
      and σ:"(σ = compose (map (λi. (τ i)) [0 ..< (Suc n)]))" by auto
    let ?τ = "compose (map (λi. (τ i)) [0 ..< n])"
    let ?σ = "if n = 0 then Var else ?τ"
    let ?f = "λi. (if i ≤ n then f i else undefined)"
     from relchain obtain U where U:"f n = U" by simp
    from relchain have nchain:"∀i < n. ((f i), (f (Suc i)), (τ i)) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step" by simp
    have "(∃f τ. f 0 = S ∧ f n = U ∧ (∀i < n. ((f i), (f (Suc i)), (τ i)) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step))"
      by (rule exI[of _ "?f"] rule exI[of _ "?σ"], insert U f0 nchain, auto)
    moreover have "multiset_narrowing_derivation_num S U ?σ n" unfolding multiset_narrowing_derivation_num_def
      using U calculation f0 nchain by (auto, smt (verit, ccfv_threshold) CollectI multiset_narrowing_step'_def relpow_fun_conv)
    ultimately have IH:"(subst_term_multiset ?σ S, U) ∈ multiset_reduction_step⇧*" using Suc(1) by auto
    have "(U, S', τ n) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step" using relchain fsucn U by auto
    from multiset_narrowing_based_reachable_single[OF this]
    have *:"(subst_term_multiset (τ n) U, S') ∈ multiset_reduction_step" by auto
    have σ:"σ = ?σ ∘⇩s (τ n)" using σ by auto 
    from subst_closed_multiset_reduction[of "subst_term_multiset ?σ S" U "τ n"]
    have "(subst_term_multiset σ S, subst_term_multiset (τ n) U) ∈ multiset_reduction_step⇧*" using σ
      by (simp add: IH subst_term_multiset_compose)
    then show ?case using * by auto
  qed
qed

lemma addFunT:assumes "(∀s∈#S. s = Fun ⊤ [])"
  and "(∀t∈#T. t = Fun ⊤ [])"
shows "∀u ∈# S + T. u = Fun ⊤ []" using assms 
  by (meson union_iff)

lemma multiset_red_add:assumes st:"(S, T) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧*"
  shows "(S + U, T + U) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧*" using assms
proof (induct rule:rtrancl.induct)
  case (rtrancl_refl a)
  then show ?case by auto
next
  case (rtrancl_into_rtrancl a b c)
  from ‹(b, c) ∈ multiset_reduction_step›
  obtain s rl σ p where s:"s ∈# b" and c:"c = ((b - {#s#}) + {#replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ)#})" and rl:"rl ∈ R" and 
    p:"p ∈ poss s" and sp:"(s |_ p = (fst rl) ⋅ σ)" using mul_reduction_correspondence by blast
  hence "(b + U, c + U) ∈ multiset_reduction_step"
    by (smt (verit, ccfv_threshold) add.assoc add.commute add_mset_remove_trivial insert_DiffM 
        multiset_reduction_step.simps rtrancl_into_rtrancl.hyps(3) union_iff union_mset_add_mset_right)
  then show ?case using rtrancl_into_rtrancl by auto
qed

lemma multiset_red_combine_goal: assumes UT:"(U, T) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧* ∧ (∀ t ∈# T. t = Fun (⊤) [])"
  and VT':"(V, T') ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧* ∧ (∀ t ∈# T'. t = Fun (⊤) [])"
shows "∃P. (U + V, P) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧* ∧ (∀ t ∈# P. t = Fun (⊤) [])" using assms
proof -
  have "(U + V, T + V) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧*" using multiset_red_add UT by auto
  moreover have "(T + V, T + T') ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧*" using multiset_red_add VT' by (metis add.commute)
  moreover have "(U + V, T + T') ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧*" using calculation(1) calculation(2) by auto
  ultimately show ?thesis by (meson UT VT' union_iff)
qed

lemma multiset_red_refl: "({#Fun ≐ [u, u]#}, {#Fun (⊤) []#}) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)" 
proof -
  have "∃x. ((Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x], Fun (⊤) [])) ∈ R" using R' by auto
  then obtain x::'v where rl:"((Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x], Fun (⊤) [])) ∈ R" by auto
  have "is_Fun (Fun ≐ [u, u])" by auto
  let ?p = "[]::pos"
  let ?s = "Fun ≐ [u, u]"
  let ?σ = "Var (x := u)" 
  let ?rl = "(Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x], Fun (⊤) [])"
  have *:"snd ?rl ⋅ ?σ = Fun (⊤) []" by auto
  have "({#Fun ≐ [u, u]#}, {#Fun ⊤ []#}) ∈ multiset_reduction_step_pos"
  proof(intro multiset_reduction_step_pos.intros conjI)
    show "?s ∈# {#Fun ≐ [u, u]#}" by auto
    show "{#Fun ⊤ []#} = {#Fun ≐ [u, u]#} - {#?s#} + {#(ctxt_of_pos_term ?p ?s)⟨snd ?rl ⋅ ?σ⟩#}" 
      using empty_not_add_mset unfolding subst_term_multiset_def by auto
    show "?rl ∈ R" using rl by auto
    show "?p ∈ poss ?s" by simp
    show "?s |_ ?p = fst ?rl ⋅ ?σ" using * by auto
  qed
  then show ?thesis using mul_reduction_correspondence 
    by (smt (verit, best) multiset_narrowing.multiset_reduction_step.simps multiset_narrowing.multiset_reduction_step_posE multiset_narrowing_axioms prod.exhaust_sel replace_at_ident rstepI)
qed

lemma trans_reachable_cond_red_step:assumes "(P, Q) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)"
  and "(Q, T) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧* ∧ (∀ t ∈# T. t = Fun (⊤) [])"
shows "(P, T) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧* ∧ (∀ t ∈# T. t = Fun (⊤) [])" using assms by auto

lemma cond_red_combine_fun: assumes "({#Fun ≐ [s⇩1 ⋅ σ, t⇩1 ⋅ σ]#}, T (s⇩1, t⇩1)) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧* ∧ (∀t∈#T (s⇩1, t⇩1). t = Fun ⊤ [])" 
  and "({#Fun ≐ [s⇩2 ⋅ σ, t⇩2 ⋅ σ]#}, T (s⇩2, t⇩2)) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧* ∧ (∀t∈#T (s⇩2, t⇩2). t = Fun ⊤ [])" 
shows "({#Fun ≐ [s⇩1 ⋅ σ, t⇩1 ⋅ σ], Fun ≐ [s⇩2 ⋅ σ, t⇩2 ⋅ σ] #},
    T (s⇩1, t⇩1) + T (s⇩2, t⇩2)) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧* ∧ (∀t∈# T (s⇩1, t⇩1) + T (s⇩2, t⇩2). t = Fun ⊤ [])" using multiset_red_combine_goal 
  by (smt (verit, ccfv_SIG) addFunT add_mset_add_single assms(1) assms(2) multiset_red_add converse_rtrancl_into_rtrancl rtrancl_idemp union_commute)

lemma cond_red_combine_fun_mset: assumes "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i)∈# mset xs. ({#Fun ≐ [s⇩i ⋅ σ, t⇩i ⋅ σ]#}, T (s⇩i, t⇩i)) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧*" 
  shows "({#Fun ≐ [s⇩i ⋅ σ, t⇩i ⋅ σ]. (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈# mset xs #},
    ∑(u, v)∈# mset xs. T (u, v)) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧*" using assms 
proof (induct xs)
  case (Cons pair xs)
  then show ?case using cond_red_combine_fun multiset_red_add union_commute
    by auto (smt (verit) add_mset_add_single converse_rtrancl_into_rtrancl 
        rtrancl_idemp union_commute)
qed auto 

lemma normRR':"normal_subst R σ ⟹ normal_subst R' σ" using R' unfolding normal_subst_def by blast

lemma not_reducible_T_erstep:"¬ (∃M. ({#Fun (⊤) []#}, M) ∈ multiset_reduction_step)" 
proof(rule ccontr)
  assume "¬ ?thesis"
  then obtain M where *:"({#Fun (⊤) []#}, M) ∈ multiset_reduction_step" by auto
  then obtain s S p rl σ where s:"s = Fun (⊤) []" and S:"S = {#Fun (⊤) []#}" and sS:"s ∈# S" and 
    M:"M = ((S - {#s#}) + {#replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ)#})" and rl:"rl ∈ R" and p:"p ∈ fun_poss s" and 
    sp:"(s |_ p = (fst rl) ⋅ σ)" using mul_reduction_correspondence not_reducible_T by auto
  from M S s have "M = {#replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ)#}" by auto
  have "∀t. (Fun (⊤) [], t) ∉ (rstep R)" using R_sig not_reducible_T by auto
  then show False using s S sS M rl p sp ctxt_supt_id fun_poss_imp_poss prod.exhaust_sel rstep.rstep
    by metis
qed

definition subst_equations_list :: "('f, 'v) subst ⇒ ('f, 'v) rule list ⇒ ('f, 'v) rule list" where 
  "subst_equations_list σ xs = map (λp.  subst_equation σ p) xs"

fun convert_equations_into_term_multiset:: "('f, 'v) rule list ⇒ ('f, 'v) term multiset"
  where 
    "convert_equations_into_term_multiset [] = {#}"
  | "convert_equations_into_term_multiset xs = {# Fun (≐) [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset xs #}"

lemma convert_equations_into_rule_list_sound: fixes rl::"('f, 'v) rule list"
  assumes "funas_trs (set rl) ⊆ F"
  shows "wf_equational_term_mset (convert_equations_into_term_multiset rl)" 
proof(cases "rl = []")
  case True
  then show ?thesis 
    by (simp add: wf_equational_term_def wf_equational_term_mset_def)
next
  case False
  have "funas_trs (set rl) ⊆ F" 
    unfolding funas_trs_def using assms funas_trs_def by blast
  moreover have *:"(≐, 2) ∉ funas_trs (set rl) ∧ (⊤, 0) ∉ funas_trs (set rl)"
    using D D_fresh calculation by auto
  let ?C = "convert_equations_into_term_multiset rl"
  have "∀t ∈# ?C. ∃(u::('f, 'v)term) v::('f, 'v)term. t = Fun (≐) [u, v] ∧ (≐, 2) ∉ funas_term u ∧ (≐, 2) ∉ funas_term v ∧
     (⊤, 0) ∉ funas_term u ∧ (⊤, 0) ∉ funas_term v"
  proof
    fix t
    assume "t ∈# ?C"
    hence "t ∈# {# Fun (≐) [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset rl #}" 
      using False by (smt (verit, ccfv_threshold) convert_equations_into_term_multiset.simps(2) list.exhaust)
    then obtain u v where t:"t = Fun (≐) [u, v]" and uv:"(u, v) ∈# mset rl" by auto
    have "(≐, 2) ∉ funas_term u ∧ (≐, 2) ∉ funas_term v" using * uv lhs_wf rhs_wf by fastforce
    moreover have "(⊤, 0) ∉ funas_term u ∧ (⊤, 0) ∉ funas_term v" using * uv lhs_wf rhs_wf by fastforce
    ultimately show "∃ u v. t = Fun (≐) [u, v] ∧ (≐, 2) ∉ funas_term u ∧ (≐, 2) ∉ funas_term v ∧
       (⊤, 0) ∉ funas_term u ∧ (⊤, 0) ∉ funas_term v" using t by auto
  qed  
  then show ?thesis by (simp add: wf_equational_term_def wf_equational_term_mset_def) 
qed

definition "multiset_narrowing_reaches_to_success C ⟷  (∃σ S'. multiset_narrowing_derivation (convert_equations_into_term_multiset C) S' σ ∧ 
    (∀ s ∈# S'. s = Fun (⊤) []))"

lemma subst_Fun_mset_equiv: fixes τ::"('f, 'v)subst"
  shows "{#t ⋅ τ. t ∈# {#Fun ≐ [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset S#}#} = {#Fun ≐ [u ⋅ τ, v ⋅ τ]. (u, v) ∈# mset S#}"
proof(induct S)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by auto
next
  case (Cons p S)
  then show ?case by (auto split:prod.splits)
qed

lemma multiset_reduction_step_divide:
  assumes AB:"(A + B, T) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧*"
    and T:"(∀t ∈# T. t = Fun (⊤) [])"
  shows "∃T'. (A, T') ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧* ∧ T' ⊆# T" using assms 
proof -
  from AB T obtain n where nstep:"(A + B, T) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)^^n" and 
    goal:"(∀t ∈# T. t = Fun (⊤) [])" by auto
  hence "∃T'. (A, T') ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧* ∧ T' ⊆# T"
  proof(induct n arbitrary:A B)
    case 0
    then show ?case by auto
  next
    case (Suc n)
    from Suc(2) obtain U where step:"(A + B, U) ∈ multiset_reduction_step" and UT:"(U, T) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)^^n" 
      by (meson relpow_Suc_E2)
    from step obtain s p rl σ where sS:"s ∈# A + B" and U:"U = ((A + B - {#s#}) + {#replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ)#})"
      and rl:"rl ∈ R" and pfun:"p ∈ poss s" and sp:"(s |_ p = (fst rl) ⋅ σ)" using mul_reduction_correspondence by blast
    from sS have "s ∈# A ∨ s ∈# B" by auto
    then show ?case
    proof
      assume sB:"s ∈# B"
      let ?B = "B - {#s#} + {#replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ)#}"
      from sB have U:"U = A + ?B" using U by auto
      then show ?thesis using Suc(1) UT goal by blast 
    next
      assume sA:"s ∈# A"
      let ?A = "A - {#s#} + {#replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ)#}"
      from sA have U:"U = ?A + B" using U by auto
      then show ?thesis using Suc(1) UT goal 
        by (smt (verit, del_insts) converse_rtrancl_into_rtrancl ctxt_supt_id multiset_reduction_stepI pfun prod.exhaust_sel rl rstepI sA sp)
    qed
  qed
  then show ?thesis by auto
qed

lemma multiset_reduction_step_pre_unifiability: fixes C::"(('f, 'v) term × ('f, 'v) term) list"
  assumes funas_C:"funas_trs (set C) ⊆ F"
    and uv:"(u, v) ∈ set C"                                      
    and ersteps:"({#Fun ≐ [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset C#}, T) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧+ ∧ (∀t ∈# T. t = Fun (⊤) [])"
  shows "({#Fun ≐ [u, v]#}, {#Fun (⊤) []#}) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧+"
proof -
  from uv have neq:"Fun ≐ [u, v] ≠ Fun (⊤) []" by auto
  have funas_uv:"funas_rule (u, v) ⊆ F" using funas_C uv unfolding funas_defs by auto
    (meson funas_C lhs_wf subsetD, meson funas_C in_mono rhs_wf)
  let ?A = "{#Fun ≐ [u, v]#}"
  let ?C = "mset C - {#(u, v)#}"
  let ?B = "{#Fun ≐ [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# ?C#}"
  have "(?A + ?B, T) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧+" using ersteps 
    by (auto, metis (no_types, lifting) case_prod_conv image_mset_add_mset in_multiset_in_set insert_DiffM uv)
  hence *:"(?A + ?B, T) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧*" by auto
  have **:"(∀t ∈# T. t = Fun (⊤) [])" using ersteps ..
  from multiset_reduction_step_divide[OF * ** ]
  have ***:"∃T'. (?A, T') ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧* ∧ T' ⊆# T" by auto
  then obtain T' where AT':"(?A, T') ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧* ∧ T' ⊆# T" using *** by auto
  from AT' obtain n where "(?A, T') ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)^^n" and T':"T' ⊆# T" by auto
  hence "T' = {#Fun (⊤) []#}" using ** T' funas_uv
  proof(induct n arbitrary:u v T')
    case 0
    then show ?case by auto
  next
    case (Suc n)
    from Suc(2) obtain U where uvU:"({#Fun ≐ [u, v]#}, U) ∈ multiset_reduction_step"
      and UT':"(U, T') ∈ multiset_reduction_step ^^ n" by (meson relpow_Suc_E2)
    from uvU obtain  s p rl σ where s:"s = Fun ≐ [u, v]" and U:"U = {#replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ)#}" and rl:"rl ∈ R" 
      and pfun:"p ∈ poss s" and sp:"s|_ p = (fst rl) ⋅ σ"  by (smt (verit) add_mset_add_single add_mset_eq_single 
          insert_DiffM mul_reduction_correspondence multiset_reduction_step_posE)
    have wf_s:"wf_equational_term s" unfolding wf_equational_term_def funas_defs using funas_uv 
      by (metis Suc.prems(5) convert_equation_into_term_sound fst_conv s snd_conv wf_equational_term_def)
    have nu:"(≐, 2) ∉ funas_term u" and nv:"(≐, 2) ∉ funas_term v" using Suc(6) D D_fresh unfolding funas_defs 
      using subset_eq D D_fresh Suc.prems(5) funas_defs(2) by fastforce+
    have poss_us:"∀q ∈ poss u. u |_ q = s |_ (0 # q)" using s by auto  
    have poss_vs:"∀q' ∈ poss v. v |_ q' = s |_ (1 # q')" using s by auto
    let ?srule = "λx. (Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x], Fun (⊤) [])"
    have fr:"∀x. funas_rule (?srule x) = {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}" using D 
      unfolding funas_defs by (auto simp add: numeral_2_eq_2)
    have cd:"∀x. funas_rule (?srule x) ⊆ D" using D 
      unfolding funas_defs by (auto simp add: numeral_2_eq_2)
    have rlR':"rl ∈ R' ∨ (∃x. rl = ?srule x)" using R' rl by fastforce
    moreover have rlR'_un:"funas_rule rl ⊆ F ∨ (∃x. rl = ?srule x)" 
      using R_sig by (metis funas_defs(2) le_supI lhs_wf prod.exhaust_sel rhs_wf rlR')
    ultimately have funas_rl:"funas_rule rl ⊆ F ∨ funas_rule rl = {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}"
      using fr by metis
    then consider (ordinary) "funas_rule rl ⊆ F" | (special) "funas_rule rl = {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}" by auto
    then show ?case
    proof(cases)
      case (special)
      have "funas_rule rl = {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}"
      proof(rule ccontr)
        assume asm:"¬ ?thesis"
        have "funas_rule rl = D" using special
          by (simp add: D)
        then show False using asm D by simp
      qed
      hence "(∃x. rl = ?srule x)" using s sp rl funas_rl R' R_sig D D_fresh unfolding funas_defs 
        using rlR'_un special by force
      then obtain x where rlx:"rl = ?srule x" by auto
      with pfun have root_s:"root (s|_ p) = Some (≐, 2)" using sp funas_uv unfolding funas_defs by auto
      have ptop:"p = []"
      proof (rule ccontr)
        assume "¬ ?thesis"
        hence "u ⊵ (s |_ p) ∨ v ⊵ (s |_ p)" using pfun s by auto
            (metis diff_Suc_1 less_Suc0 less_Suc_eq nth_Cons' subt_at_imp_supteq)
        then show False using root_s nu nv unfolding funas_defs
          by (meson root_symbol_in_funas subset_eq supteq_imp_funas_term_subset)
      qed
      hence *:"replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ) = Fun (⊤) []" using s rlx by auto
      hence "U = {#Fun (⊤) []#}" using U by fastforce
      then show ?thesis using not_reducible_T_erstep UT' by (metis relpow_E2)
    next
      case ordinary
      hence rlR':"rl ∈ R'" using R' D R_sig D_fresh 
        by (metis fr inf.orderE insert_not_empty rlR')
      from fun_root_not_None have nroot:"root (fst rl) ≠ None" 
        by (metis is_Fun_Fun_conv local.wf prod.collapse rl wf_trs_imp_lhs_Fun)
      from root_not_special_symbols[OF rlR' ordinary nroot]
      have *:"root (fst rl) ≠ Some (≐, 2) ∧ root (fst rl) ≠  Some (⊤, 0)" by simp
      hence root_eq:"root (s |_ p) = root(fst rl)" using s
        by (metis (no_types, opaque_lifting) R' empty_pos_in_poss le_sup_iff local.wf poss_is_Fun_fun_poss 
            prod.exhaust_sel rlR' root_subst_inv sp subset_iff subt_at.simps(1) term.disc(2) wf_trs_def)
      hence "root (s |_ p) ≠ Some (≐, 2) ∧ root (s |_ p) ≠ Some (⊤, 0)" using * by force
      hence np:"p ≠ []" using wf_s[unfolded wf_equational_term_def] by force
      hence "∃q r. (q ∈ poss u ∧ p = 0 # q) ∨ (r ∈ poss v ∧ p = 1 # r)" using s ordinary pfun 
      proof(auto, goal_cases)
        case (1 x p)
        then show ?case using less_2_cases numeral_2_eq_2 by fastforce
      next
        case (2 x p)
        then show ?case by (metis less_2_cases nth_Cons_0 nth_Cons_Suc numeral_2_eq_2)
      next
        case (3 x p)
        then show ?case by (metis  less_2_cases nth_Cons_0 numeral_2_eq_2)
      qed
      then obtain q r where qpos:"(q ∈ poss u ∧ p = 0 # q) ∨ (r ∈ poss v ∧ p = 1 # r)" (is "?A ∨ ?B") by auto
      then show ?thesis 
      proof
        assume asm:?A
        hence *:"replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ) = Fun ≐ [(replace_at u q ((snd rl) ⋅ σ)), v]"  using s by auto
        hence "U = {#Fun ≐ [(replace_at u q ((snd rl) ⋅ σ)), v]#}" using U by auto
        moreover have "funas_rule (replace_at u q ((snd rl) ⋅ σ), v) ⊆ F" using funas_uv wf_F_subst ordinary unfolding funas_defs
          by auto (metis Suc.prems(5) asm ctxt_supt_id fst_conv funas_rule_def funas_term_ctxt_apply le_supE subsetD,
              metis Suc.prems(5) funas_rule_def le_sup_iff snd_conv subsetD)
        ultimately show ?thesis using ** Suc UT' by auto
      next
        assume asm:?B
        hence "replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ) = Fun ≐ [u , (replace_at v r ((snd rl) ⋅ σ))]" using s by auto
         hence "U = {#Fun ≐ [u , (replace_at v r ((snd rl) ⋅ σ))]#}" using U by auto
        moreover have "funas_rule (u , (replace_at v r ((snd rl) ⋅ σ))) ⊆ F" using funas_uv wf_F_subst ordinary unfolding funas_defs
          by auto (metis Suc.prems(5) fst_conv funas_rule_def le_sup_iff subsetD,
           metis Suc.prems(5) asm ctxt_supt_id funas_rule_def funas_term_ctxt_apply le_supE snd_conv subsetD)
        ultimately show ?thesis using ** Suc.hyps Suc.prems(2) UT' by auto
      qed
    qed
  qed
  then show ?thesis using AT' by (meson neq add_mset_eq_single rtranclD)
qed

lemma multiset_reduction_single: assumes funas_uv:"funas_rule (u, v) ⊆ F"
    and ersteps:"({#Fun ≐ [u, v]#}, {#Fun (⊤) []#}) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧+"
  shows "((u, v) ∈ (rstep R)⇧↔⇧*)" 
proof -
  from ersteps obtain n where step:"({#Fun ≐ [u, v]#}, {#Fun (⊤) []#}) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)^^n" and n1:"n ≥ 1" 
    by (metis add_mset_eq_single less_one list.simps(3) relpow_0_E rtrancl_imp_relpow term.inject(2) trancl_into_rtrancl verit_comp_simplify1(3))
  then show ?thesis using funas_uv
  proof(induct n arbitrary:u v)
    case 0
    then show ?case by auto
  next
    case (Suc n)
    with step obtain U where uvU:"({#Fun ≐ [u, v]#}, U) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)" and 
      UG:"(U, {#Fun (⊤) []#}) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)^^n" by (meson relpow_Suc_D2)
    from uvU obtain  s p rl σ where s:"s = Fun ≐ [u, v]" and U:"U = {#replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ)#}" and rl:"rl ∈ R" 
      and pfun:"p ∈ poss s" and sp:"s|_ p = (fst rl) ⋅ σ" 
      by (smt (verit) add_mset_add_single add_mset_eq_single insert_DiffM mul_reduction_correspondence multiset_reduction_step_posE)
    have wf_s:"wf_equational_term s" unfolding wf_equational_term_def funas_defs using funas_uv 
      by (metis Suc.prems(3) convert_equation_into_term_sound fst_conv s snd_conv wf_equational_term_def) 
    have nu:"(≐, 2) ∉ funas_term u" and nv:"(≐, 2) ∉ funas_term v" using Suc(4) D D_fresh unfolding funas_defs by auto 
    have poss_us:"∀q ∈ poss u. u |_ q = s |_ (0 # q)" using s by auto  
    have poss_vs:"∀q' ∈ poss v. v |_ q' = s |_ (1 # q')" using s by auto
    let ?srule = "λx. (Fun (≐) [Var x, Var x], Fun (⊤) [])"
    have fr:"∀x. funas_rule (?srule x) = {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}" using D 
      unfolding funas_defs by (auto simp add: numeral_2_eq_2)
    have cd:"∀x. funas_rule (?srule x) ⊆ D" using D 
      unfolding funas_defs by (auto simp add: numeral_2_eq_2)
    have rlR':"rl ∈ R' ∨ (∃x. rl = ?srule x)" using R' rl by fastforce
    moreover have rlR'_un:"funas_rule rl ⊆ F ∨ (∃x. rl = ?srule x)" 
      using R_sig by (metis funas_defs(2) le_supI lhs_wf prod.exhaust_sel rhs_wf rlR')
    ultimately have funas_rl:"funas_rule rl ⊆ F ∨ funas_rule rl = {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}"
      using fr by metis
    then consider (ordinary) "funas_rule rl ⊆ F" | (special) "funas_rule rl = {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}" by auto
    then show ?case
    proof(cases)
      case (special)
      have "funas_rule rl = {(≐, 2), (⊤, 0)}"
      proof(rule ccontr)
        assume asm:"¬ ?thesis"
        have "funas_rule rl = D" using special
          by (simp add: D)
        then show False using asm D by simp
      qed
      hence "(∃x. rl = ?srule x)" using s sp rl funas_rl R' R_sig D D_fresh unfolding funas_defs 
        using rlR'_un special by force
      then obtain x where rlx:"rl = ?srule x" by auto
      with pfun have root_s:"root (s|_ p) = Some (≐, 2)" using sp funas_uv unfolding funas_defs by auto
      have ptop:"p = []"
      proof (rule ccontr)
        assume "¬ ?thesis"
        hence "u ⊵ (s |_ p) ∨ v ⊵ (s |_ p)" using pfun s by auto
            (metis diff_Suc_1 less_Suc0 less_Suc_eq nth_Cons' subt_at_imp_supteq)
        then show False using root_s nu nv unfolding funas_defs
          by (meson root_symbol_in_funas subset_eq supteq_imp_funas_term_subset)
      qed
      hence *:"replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ) = Fun (⊤) []" using s rlx by auto
      hence "u = v" using s rlx sp by (simp add: ptop)
      then show ?thesis by auto
    next
      case ordinary
      hence rlR':"rl ∈ R'" using R' D R_sig D_fresh 
        by (metis fr inf.orderE insert_not_empty rlR')
      from fun_root_not_None have nroot:"root (fst rl) ≠ None" 
        by (metis is_Fun_Fun_conv local.wf prod.collapse rl wf_trs_imp_lhs_Fun)
      from root_not_special_symbols[OF rlR' ordinary nroot]
      have *:"root (fst rl) ≠ Some (≐, 2) ∧ root (fst rl) ≠  Some (⊤, 0)" by simp
      hence root_eq:"root (s |_ p) = root(fst rl)" using s
        by (metis (no_types, opaque_lifting) R' empty_pos_in_poss le_sup_iff local.wf poss_is_Fun_fun_poss 
            prod.exhaust_sel rlR' root_subst_inv sp subset_iff subt_at.simps(1) term.disc(2) wf_trs_def)
      hence "root (s |_ p) ≠ Some (≐, 2) ∧ root (s |_ p) ≠ Some (⊤, 0)" using * by force
      hence np:"p ≠ []" using wf_s[unfolded wf_equational_term_def] by force
      hence "∃q r. (q ∈ poss u ∧ p = 0 # q) ∨ (r ∈ poss v ∧ p = 1 # r)" using s ordinary pfun 
      proof(auto, goal_cases)
        case (1 x p)
        then show ?case using less_2_cases numeral_2_eq_2 by fastforce
      next
        case (2 x p)
        then show ?case by (metis less_2_cases nth_Cons_0 nth_Cons_Suc numeral_2_eq_2)
      next
        case (3 x p)
        then show ?case by (metis less_2_cases nth_Cons_0 numeral_2_eq_2)
      qed
      then obtain q r where qpos:"(q ∈ poss u ∧ p = 0 # q) ∨ (r ∈ poss v ∧ p = 1 # r)" (is "?A ∨ ?B") by auto
      then show ?thesis
      proof
        assume asm:?A
        hence *:"replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ) = Fun ≐ [(replace_at u q ((snd rl) ⋅ σ)), v]"  using s by auto
        hence "U = {#Fun ≐ [(replace_at u q ((snd rl) ⋅ σ)), v]#}" using U by auto
        moreover have "funas_rule (replace_at u q ((snd rl) ⋅ σ), v) ⊆ F" using funas_uv wf_F_subst ordinary unfolding funas_defs
          by auto (metis Suc.prems(3) asm ctxt_supt_id fst_conv funas_rule_def funas_term_ctxt_apply le_sup_iff subsetD,
              metis Suc.prems(3) UnI2 funas_rule_def in_mono snd_eqD)
        moreover have "(replace_at u q ((snd rl) ⋅ σ), v) ∈ (rstep R)⇧↔⇧*" using Suc(1) UG 
          by (metis One_nat_def Suc.prems(2) calculation(1) calculation(2) le_SucE list.simps(3) 
              nat.inject relpow_0_E single_eq_single term.inject(2))
        ultimately show ?thesis 
          by (metis (no_types, lifting) asm conversionI' conversion_rtrancl ctxt_supt_id poss_us 
              prod.collapse r_into_rtrancl rl rstepI rtrancl.rtrancl_into_rtrancl sp)
      next
        assume asm:?B
        hence "replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ) = Fun ≐ [u , (replace_at v r ((snd rl) ⋅ σ))]" using s by auto
         hence "U = {#Fun ≐ [u , (replace_at v r ((snd rl) ⋅ σ))]#}" using U by auto
        moreover have "funas_rule (u , (replace_at v r ((snd rl) ⋅ σ))) ⊆ F" using funas_uv wf_F_subst ordinary unfolding funas_defs
          by auto (metis Suc.prems(3) UnI1 fst_eqD funas_rule_def in_mono, metis Suc.prems(3) asm ctxt_supt_id 
              funas_rule_def funas_term_ctxt_apply le_sup_iff snd_conv subsetD)
        moreover have "(u , (replace_at v r ((snd rl) ⋅ σ))) ∈ (rstep R)⇧↔⇧*" using Suc(1) UG 
          by (metis One_nat_def Suc.prems(2) calculation(1) calculation(2) le_SucE list.simps(3) 
              nat.inject relpow_0_E single_eq_single term.inject(2))
        ultimately show ?thesis 
          by (smt (verit, ccfv_SIG) asm conversionI' conversion_ctxt_closed conversion_inv conversion_rtrancl 
              conversion_subst_closed ctxt_supt_id poss_vs prod.exhaust_sel r_into_rtrancl rl 
              rtrancl.rtrancl_into_rtrancl sp subsetD subset_rstep)
      qed
    qed
  qed
qed

lemma multiset_reduction_step_unifiability: 
  assumes funas_C:"funas_trs (set C) ⊆ F"
    and ersteps:"({#Fun ≐ [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset C#}, T) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧+ ∧ (∀t ∈# T. t = Fun (⊤) [])"
  shows "∀u v. (u, v) ∈ set C ⟶ ((u, v) ∈ (rstep R)⇧↔⇧*)"
proof -
  { fix u v
    assume asm:"(u, v) ∈ set C"
    with ersteps have *:"({#Fun ≐ [u, v]#}, {#Fun (⊤) []#}) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧+"
      using multiset_reduction_step_pre_unifiability funas_C by auto
    have "funas_rule (u, v) ⊆ F" unfolding funas_defs using asm funas_C by auto (meson in_mono lhs_wf, 
          meson rhs_wf subsetD)
    hence "((u, v) ∈ (rstep R)⇧↔⇧*)" using multiset_reduction_single * by auto
  } then show ?thesis by auto
qed

(* A sufficient condition of satisfying the R-unification problem *)
lemma multiset_narrowing_based_R_unifiable: assumes funas_C:"funas_trs (set C) ⊆ F"
  and not_empty:"set C ≠ {}"
  and nd:"(∃σ S'. multiset_narrowing_derivation (convert_equations_into_term_multiset C) S' σ ∧ (∀ s ∈# S'. s = Fun (⊤) []))"
shows "R_unifiable C" 
proof -
  let ?C = "convert_equations_into_term_multiset C"
  from assms obtain σ S' where nd:"multiset_narrowing_derivation ?C S' σ" and goal:"(∀ s ∈# S'. s = Fun (⊤) [])" by auto
  have neq:"∀u v σ. Fun (⊤) [] ≠ Fun (≐) [u ⋅ σ, v ⋅ σ]" by auto 
  from multiset_narrowing_reduction[OF nd]
  have estep:"(subst_term_multiset σ ?C, S') ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧*" by auto
  moreover have estep_trans:"(subst_term_multiset σ ?C, S') ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧+"
  proof -
    have "(subst_term_multiset σ ?C, S') ∉ (multiset_reduction_step)^^0"
    proof(rule ccontr)
      assume "¬ ?thesis"
      hence "(subst_term_multiset σ ?C, S') ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)^^0" by auto
      hence eq:"subst_term_multiset σ ?C =  S'" by auto
      have *:"(⊤, 0) ∉ funas_trs (set C)" using funas_C D D_fresh by auto
      have Cq:"?C = {# Fun (≐) [u, v]. (u, v) ∈# mset C #}" 
        by (metis (no_types, lifting) convert_equations_into_term_multiset.elims image_mset_is_empty_iff mset.simps(1))
      hence **:"subst_term_multiset σ ?C = {# Fun (≐) [u ⋅ σ, v ⋅ σ]. (u, v) ∈# mset C #}" unfolding subst_term_multiset_def
        using subst_Fun_mset_equiv by auto
      hence root1:"∀s ∈# subst_term_multiset σ ?C. (≐, 2) ∈ funas_term s" using eq goal by fastforce 
      moreover have root2:"∀ s ∈# S'. funas_term s = {(⊤, 0)}" using goal  ** eq by auto
      moreover have "subst_term_multiset σ ?C ≠ {#}" using funas_C not_empty  unfolding funas_defs subst_term_multiset_def  
        by (simp add: Cq)
      moreover have "S' ≠ {#}" using goal calculation(3) eq by auto
      ultimately show False using eq by auto
    qed
    then show ?thesis by (metis estep relpow_0_I rtranclD)
  qed
  moreover have subC:"subst_term_multiset σ ?C = {#Fun ≐ [u ⋅ σ, v ⋅ σ]. (u, v) ∈# mset C#}" unfolding subst_term_multiset_def 
    by (metis (no_types, lifting) convert_equations_into_term_multiset.elims image_mset_is_empty_iff mset_zero_iff subst_Fun_mset_equiv)
  moreover have subC2:"... = {#Fun ≐ [u , v]. (u, v) ∈# mset (subst_equations_list σ C)#}" unfolding subst_equations_list_def subst_equation_def 
      subst_term_multiset_def by (auto, smt (verit, ccfv_SIG) fstI multiset.map_comp multiset.map_cong0 o_apply sndI split_beta)
  ultimately have *:"({#Fun ≐ [u , v]. (u, v) ∈# mset (subst_equations_list σ C)#}, S') ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧*" by auto
  have **:"funas_trs (set (subst_equations_list σ C)) ⊆ F" unfolding funas_defs subst_equations_list_def subst_equation_def
    using wf_F_subst by auto (meson funas_C in_mono lhs_wf, meson funas_C rhs_wf subsetD)
  from multiset_reduction_step_unifiability[of "subst_equations_list σ C" S']
  have "∀u v. (u, v) ∈ set (subst_equations_list σ C) ⟶ ((u, v) ∈ (rstep R)⇧↔⇧*)" using funas_C * ** goal 
    estep_trans subC subC2 by auto
  then show ?thesis unfolding R_unifiable_def subst_equations_list_def subst_equation_def 
    by (auto, smt (verit, ccfv_threshold) fst_conv image_eqI snd_conv)
qed

(* The following lemma shows the soundness of multiset narrowing *)
lemma lifting_lemma_for_multiset_narrowing:
  fixes V::"('v::infinite) set" and S::"('f, 'v)term multiset" and T::"('f, 'v)term multiset"
  assumes "normal_subst R θ"
    and "T = subst_term_multiset θ S"
    and "vars_term_set (set_mset S) ∪ subst_domain θ ⊆ V"
    and mrsteps:"(T,  T') ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧*"
    and fv:"finite V"
  shows "∃σ θ' S'. multiset_narrowing_derivation S S' σ ∧ T' = subst_term_multiset θ' S' ∧
      normal_subst R θ' ∧ (σ ∘⇩s θ') |s V = θ |s V"
proof -
  from mrsteps obtain f n where f0:"f 0 = T" and fn:"f n = T'" and rel_chain:"∀i < n. (f i,  f (Suc i)) ∈ multiset_reduction_step" 
    by (metis rtrancl_imp_seq)
  hence "∃σ θ' S'. multiset_narrowing_derivation_num S S' σ n ∧ subst_term_multiset θ' S' = T' ∧ normal_subst R θ' ∧
    (σ ∘⇩s θ') |s V = θ |s V" using assms
  proof(induct n arbitrary: S T T' θ f V rule: wf_induct[OF wf_measure [of "λ n. n"]])
    case (1 n)
    note IH1 = 1(1)[rule_format]
    then show ?case
    proof(cases "n = 0")
      case True
      show ?thesis by (rule exI[of _ Var], rule exI[of _ θ], rule exI[of _ S], 
            simp add:multiset_narrowing_derivation_num_def, insert True 1, auto)
    next
      case False
      hence f0f1:"(f 0, f 1) ∈ multiset_reduction_step" using 1 by auto
      then show ?thesis
      proof -
        from f0f1 obtain T T1 s σ rl p  where f0:"f 0 = T" and f1:"f 1 = T1" and s:"s ∈# T" and 
          T':"T1 = ((T - {#s#}) + {#replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ)#})" and rl:"rl ∈ R" and 
          red_pos:"p ∈ poss s" and s1p:"s |_ p = (fst rl) ⋅ σ"
            by (meson mul_reduction_correspondence multiset_reduction_step_posE)
        have normθ:"normal_subst R θ" by fact
        hence Ts:"T = subst_term_multiset θ S" using f0 1 by auto
        have "∃ω. V ∩ vars_rule (ω ∙ rl) = {}" using 1(9) 
          by (metis rule_fs.rename_avoiding supp_vars_rule_eq vars_rule_def)
        then obtain ω where varempty':"V ∩ vars_rule (ω ∙ rl) = {}" by auto
        hence "∃ωr. ωr ∙ ω ∙ rl ∈ R" using rl
          by (metis (no_types, opaque_lifting) rule_pt.permute_minus_cancel(2) rule_pt.permute_plus)
        then obtain ωr where ωr:"ωr ∙ (ω ∙ rl) ∈ R" by auto
        from red_pos have pfs1:"p ∈ poss s" by blast
        have ps1:"p ∈ poss s" using fun_poss_imp_poss pfs1 by blast
        hence nt:"((fst rl) ⋅ σ) ∉ NF (rstep R)"
        proof - 
          have *:"is_Fun (fst rl)" using wf[unfolded wf_trs_def] using rl 
            by (metis is_Fun_Fun_conv prod.collapse)
          let ?C = "Hole::('f, 'v)ctxt"
          from  rl * have "(fst rl ⋅ σ, snd rl ⋅ σ) ∈ rstep R" 
            by (metis prod.collapse rstep_rule rstep_subst)
          then show ?thesis by auto
        qed
        obtain u where uS':"u ∈# S" and us1:"u ⋅ θ = s" using Ts s unfolding subst_term_multiset_def by auto
        have sub_eq:"(u ⋅ θ) |_ p = (fst rl) ⋅ σ" using us1 s1p by auto
        have pu:"p ∈ fun_poss (u ⋅ θ)" using pfs1 us1
          by (metis NF_I is_VarE local.wf nt poss_is_Fun_fun_poss rstep_imp_Fun sub_eq term.distinct(1))
        have p:"p ∈ poss u" 
        proof(rule ccontr)
          assume "¬ ?thesis"
          hence pnu:"p ∉ poss u" by simp
          hence pnfu:"p ∉ fun_poss u" using fun_poss_imp_poss by blast
          from poss_subst_apply_term[of p u θ]
          obtain q r x where qpr:"p = q @ r" and qu:"q ∈ poss u" and uqx:"u |_ q = Var x" and r:"r ∈ poss (θ x)"
            using pnfu ps1 us1 by blast
          hence *:"(u ⋅ θ) |_ p = (Var x) ⋅ θ |_ r" by force
          have "((Var x) ⋅ θ) ∈ NF (rstep R)" using normθ 
            by (simp add: normal_subst_def, metis NF_I local.wf no_Var_rstep notin_subst_domain_imp_Var)
          hence "((Var x) ⋅ θ |_ r) ∈ NF (rstep R)"  
            by (auto simp add: normal_subst_def, insert r, goal_cases) 
              (meson NF_rstep_subterm subt_at_imp_supteq')
          then show False using nt * using s1p us1 by auto
        qed
        hence pfun:"p ∈ fun_poss u"  using ps1 us1 red_pos nt normθ unfolding normal_subst_def
          by (metis pu eval_term.simps(1) fun_poss_fun_conv is_VarE notin_subst_domain_imp_Var poss_is_Fun_fun_poss sub_eq subt_at_subst term.distinct(1))
        hence vuS':"vars_term (u |_ p) ⊆ vars_term_set (set_mset S)" 
        proof -
          have "vars_term (u |_ p) ⊆ vars_term u" using p 
            by (simp add: vars_term_subt_at)
          then show ?thesis using uS' vars_term_set_def by fastforce
        qed
        with varempty' have varcond:"vars_term (u |_ p) ∩ vars_rule (ω ∙ rl) = {}" using 1(7) by auto
        from vuS' have vuV:"vars_term (u |_ p) ⊆ V" using 1(7) by auto
        have "∃σr. ∀t. σr (ω ∙ t) = σ t" using atom_pt.permute_minus_cancel(2) by (metis o_apply)
        then obtain σr where σrdef:"∀t. σr (ω ∙ t) = σ t" by auto
        hence "σr = (λx. σ (- ω ∙ x))" by (metis atom_pt.permute_minus_cancel(1))
        hence σr:"σr = (λx. (sop (- ω) ∘⇩s σ) x)" 
          by (metis comp_apply permute_atom_def subst_compose_o_assoc subst_monoid_mult.mult.left_neutral)
        hence "∀S. subst_term_set σ S = subst_term_set σr (ω ∙ S)" unfolding subst_term_set_def 
        proof(auto, goal_cases)
          case (1 S t)
          then show ?case 
            by (metis term_pt.permute_flip term_set_pt.mem_permute_iff)
        next
          case (2 S xa)
          then show ?case by force
        qed
        hence pc:"fst rl ⋅ σ = fst (ω ∙ rl) ⋅ σr" 
          by (simp add: σr rule_pt.fst_eqvt)
        have pc':"snd rl ⋅ σ = snd (ω ∙ rl) ⋅ σr" 
          by (simp add: σr rule_pt.snd_eqvt rule_pt.fst_eqvt)
        let ?σr = "σr |s vars_rule (ω ∙ rl)"
        let ?σdom = "vars_rule (ω ∙ rl)"
        have sub_σr:"subst_domain ?σr ⊆ (vars_rule (ω ∙ rl))" 
          using subst_domain_restrict_subst_domain by fastforce 
        let ?θ = "θ |s V"
        have sub_θ:"subst_domain ?θ ⊆ V" using subst_domain_restrict_subst_domain by fastforce
        have inter_empty:"subst_domain ?σr ∩ subst_domain ?θ = {}" using varempty' 1(7) sub_σr by auto
        have crl:"(snd (ω ∙ rl)) ⋅ σr = ((snd rl) ⋅ σ)" 
          by (simp add: σr rule_pt.fst_eqvt rule_pt.snd_eqvt)
        note subst_rest_domain1 = subst_domain_restrict_subst_domain[of ?σdom σr]
        have subinter:"subst_domain ?σr = subst_domain σr ∩ ?σdom" using subst_rest_domain1 by auto
        from us1 s1p have *:"(u ⋅ θ |_ p) = fst (ω ∙ rl) ⋅ σr"
          by (simp add: pc subst_apply_term_restrict_subst_domain) 
        have varcond':"vars_term (u |_ p) ∩ vars_term (fst (ω ∙ rl)) = {}" 
        proof -
          have "vars_term (fst (ω ∙ rl)) ⊆ vars_rule (ω ∙ rl)"
            by (metis (mono_tags, opaque_lifting) dual_order.refl le_sup_iff vars_rule_def vars_defs(2))
          then show ?thesis using varcond by auto
        qed
        with normθ * have u_p:"(u |_ p) ⋅ θ = fst (ω ∙ rl) ⋅ σr" 
          using p by simp
        have sub_eq:"(u |_ p) ⋅ ?θ = fst (ω ∙ rl) ⋅ ?σr" using u_p 
          by (metis (no_types, lifting) 1(7) Un_upper1 coincidence_lemma' le_supE subst_domain_neutral vars_rule_def vars_defs(2))
        from subst_union_sound[OF sub_eq]
        have subst_eq_θσ:"(u |_ p) ⋅ (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr)  = (fst (ω ∙ rl)) ⋅ (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr)" using sub_σr sub_θ inter_empty
          by (smt (verit, ccfv_threshold) Int_assoc inf.orderE inf_bot_right inf_commute local.wf rl rule_pt.fst_eqvt sub_comm sub_eq subst_union_term_reduction varcond varempty' vars_rule_eqvt vars_rule_lhs vars_term_eqvt)
        then obtain δ where mgu_uv:"mgu (u |_ p) (fst (ω ∙ rl)) = Some δ" using mgu_ex 
          by (meson ex_mgu_if_subst_apply_term_eq_subst_apply_term)
        hence upωrl:"(u |_ p) ⋅ δ =  fst (ω ∙ rl) ⋅ δ" using subst_apply_term_eq_subst_apply_term_if_mgu by blast
        from mgu_sound[OF mgu_uv] have δ:"(?θ ∪⇩s ?σr) =  δ ∘⇩s (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr)" using subst_eq_θσ 
          by (smt (verit, ccfv_SIG) is_imgu_def subst_monoid_mult.mult_assoc the_mgu the_mgu_is_imgu)
        have subst_domainδ:"subst_domain δ ⊆ vars_term (u |_ p) ∪ vars_term (fst (ω ∙ rl))" 
          using mgu_subst_domain mgu_uv by blast
        have subst_range_disjδ:"subst_domain δ ∩ range_vars δ = {}" using mgu_uv mgu_subst_domain_range_vars_disjoint by blast
        let ?S = "subst_term_multiset δ ((S - {#u#}) + {#replace_at u p (snd (ω ∙ rl))#})"
        have url:"vars_term u ∩ vars_rule (ω ∙ rl) = {}" using vuV varempty' vuS' 1(7) 
          by (auto, metis Int_iff UN_I equals0D in_mono uS' vars_term_set_def)
        have nar:"(S, ?S, δ) ∈  multiset_narrowing_step_pos"
          using ωr url mgu_uv pfun uS' by blast
        hence  nar:"(S, ?S, δ) ∈  multiset_narrowing_step"
          by (smt (verit, ccfv_threshold) ωr url add_mset_add_single 
              image_mset_add_mset mgu_uv multiset_narrowing.multiset_narrowing_step.simps multiset_narrowing_axioms 
              narrowing_stepI pfun subst_term_multiset_def uS')
        from multiset_narrowing_set_imp_rtran[OF nar]
        have condn1:"multiset_narrowing_derivation_num S ?S δ 1" by auto
        let ?V = "(V - subst_domain δ) ∪ range_vars δ"
        let ?θ1 = "(?θ ∪⇩s ?σr) |s ?V"
        have subθ1:"subst_domain ?θ1 ⊆ ?V" 
          by (metis inf_le1 restrict_subst subst_domain_restrict_subst_domain)
        have reseq:"?θ1 |s ?V = (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr) |s  ?V" 
          by (simp add: restrict_subst_domain_def)
        have reseqδ:"(δ ∘⇩s ?θ1) |s V  = (δ ∘⇩s (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr)) |s V " 
          using reseq r_subst_compose by blast
        have reseqθ:"(δ ∘⇩s ?θ1)|s V = θ |s V" using  δ 1(7) by auto (smt (verit) δ disjoint_iff notin_subst_domain_imp_Var 
              reseqδ sub_σr subset_iff subst_domain_neutral subst_ext subst_union.elims varempty')
        have "normal_subst R (?θ1 |s ?V)"
        proof -
          let ?δ = "δ |s V"
          let ?B = "(V - subst_domain δ) ∪ range_vars ?δ"
          have normV:"normal_subst R (θ |s V)" using normθ 1(7) by auto
          have BV:"?B ⊆ V - subst_domain δ ∪ range_vars (δ |s V)" by auto
          from restricted_normalized[OF normV reseqθ BV]
          have normB:"normal_subst R (?θ1 |s ?B)" by auto 
          have ranB:"range_vars δ ⊆ ?B"
          proof
            fix x
            assume asm:"x ∈ range_vars δ"
            hence xnδ:"x ∉ subst_domain δ" using δ
              by (meson disjoint_iff mgu_subst_domain_range_vars_disjoint mgu_uv)
            have subst_x:"x ∈ vars_term (u |_ p) ∪ vars_term (fst (ω ∙ rl))" using mgu_uv 
                asm mgu_range_vars by auto
            then show "x ∈ ?B"
            proof
              assume "x ∈ vars_term (u |_ p)"
              hence "x ∈ V - subst_domain δ" using 1(7) xnδ vuS' by auto
              then show ?thesis by auto
            next
              assume asm2:"x ∈ vars_term (fst (ω ∙ rl))"
              hence xnu:"x ∉ vars_term (u |_ p)" using varcond' by blast
              from vars_term_range[OF asm asm2 subst_range_disjδ]
              have xvδ:"x ∈ vars_term (fst (ω ∙ rl) ⋅ δ)" by auto
              have *:"x ∈ vars_term (u |_ p ⋅ δ)" using mgu_uv xvδ
                by (simp add: subst_apply_term_eq_subst_apply_term_if_mgu) 
              hence "vars_term (fst (ω ∙ rl) ⋅ δ) = vars_term (u |_ p ⋅ δ)" using mgu_uv 
                by (simp add: subst_apply_term_eq_subst_apply_term_if_mgu)
              from subst_restricted_range_vars[OF * subst_range_disjδ xnu asm]
              have "x ∈ range_vars (δ |s vars_term (u |_ p))" by auto
              moreover have upV:"vars_term (u |_ p) ⊆ V" using 1(7) vuS' by auto
              ultimately have "x ∈ range_vars (δ |s V)" unfolding range_vars_def subst_restrict_def
                by (auto simp add: subsetD subst_domain_def) 
              then show ?thesis by auto
            qed
          qed
          hence "?B = ?V"
          proof -
            have "range_vars ?δ ⊆ range_vars δ"  unfolding subst_restrict_def range_vars_def  
              by (auto, smt (verit) mem_Collect_eq subst_domain_def, simp add: subst_domain_def)
            then show ?thesis using ranB by blast
          qed
          then show ?thesis using normB by auto
        qed
        hence normθ1:"normal_subst R ?θ1" using subθ1 reseq by fastforce
        have rel_chain':"⋀i. i < n - 1 ⟹ (f (i + 1), f (Suc i + 1)) ∈ multiset_reduction_step" using rel_chain 
          by (simp add: 1(4))
        let ?f = "λi. f (i + 1)"
        have relstar:"(f 1, f n) ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧*" using False 1(4) less_Suc_eq 
          by (induct n, blast, metis (no_types, lifting) One_nat_def rtrancl.simps)
        have varsθ:"vars_term_set (set_mset S) ∪ subst_domain θ ⊆ V" by fact
        have scomp:"?S = subst_term_multiset δ (S - {#u#}) + subst_term_multiset δ {#replace_at u p (snd (ω ∙ rl))#}" (is "?S = ?fst + ?snd")
          unfolding subst_term_multiset_def by auto
        have "subst_term_multiset δ {#replace_at u p (snd (ω ∙ rl))#} ⊆# ?S"
          by (simp add: subst_term_multiset_def)
        hence vars_subS:"vars_term_set (set_mset (subst_term_multiset δ {#replace_at u p (snd (ω ∙ rl))#})) ⊆ ?V"  
        proof -
          have "vars_term (snd rl) ⊆ vars_term (fst rl)" using wf[unfolded wf_trs_def] rl by auto
          hence *:"vars_term (snd (ω ∙ rl)) ⊆ vars_term (fst (ω ∙ rl))" using rl by auto
              (metis UnCI rule_pt.fst_eqvt rule_pt.fst_eqvt sup.absorb_iff1 vars_defs(2) vars_rule_eqvt vars_term_eqvt)
          from var_cond_stable[OF this]
          have "vars_term (snd (ω ∙ rl) ⋅ δ ) ⊆ vars_term (snd (ω ∙ rl) ⋅ δ)" by fastforce
          from replace_var_stable[OF this] 
          have "vars_term(replace_at u p (snd (ω ∙ rl)) ⋅ δ) ⊆ vars_term (replace_at u p (fst (ω ∙ rl)) ⋅ δ)" 
            by (meson "*" replace_var_stable var_cond_stable)
          moreover have "vars_term (replace_at u p (fst (ω ∙ rl)) ⋅ δ) = vars_term (u ⋅ δ)" using upωrl
            by (metis ctxt_supt_id p subst_apply_term_ctxt_apply_distrib)
          moreover have "vars_term (u ⋅ δ) ⊆ ?V" using uS' 1(7)  vars_term_set_def vars_term_subst_apply_term_subset
            by auto (fastforce, meson Diff_iff UnE subsetD vars_term_subst_apply_term_subset)
          ultimately show ?thesis unfolding vars_term_set_def subst_term_multiset_def by auto
        qed    
        have "subst_term_multiset δ (S - {#u#}) ⊆# ?S" by (simp add: subst_term_multiset_def)
        hence vars_subSu:"vars_term_set (set_mset (subst_term_multiset δ (S - {#u#}))) ⊆ ?V" 
        proof -
          have "vars_term_set (set_mset S) ⊆ V" using varsθ by auto
          hence "vars_term_set (set_mset (subst_term_multiset δ S)) ⊆ ?V" unfolding vars_term_set_def
              subst_term_multiset_def set_mset_def using vars_term_subst_apply_term_subset by fastforce+
          then show ?thesis by (smt (verit, del_insts) SUP_le_iff add_mset_add_single insert_DiffM 
                subst_term_multiset_union uS' union_iff vars_term_set_def)
        qed
        have varSV:"vars_term_set (set_mset ?S) ⊆ ?V"
        proof -
          have *:"vars_term_set (set_mset ?S) = vars_term_set (set_mset ?fst) ∪ vars_term_set (set_mset ?snd)"
            using scomp unfolding vars_term_set_def by auto
          then show ?thesis using vars_subS vars_subSu by auto
        qed
        from subst_domain_restrict_subst_domain[of ?σdom σr]
        have subinter:"subst_domain ?σr = subst_domain σr ∩ ?σdom" by auto
        have inempty:"subst_domain ?σr ∩ V = {}" using varempty' subinter by auto
        hence θsv:"(?θ ∪⇩s ?σr) |s V = θ |s V"
          using δ reseqδ reseqθ by auto
        have θvarr:"(?θ ∪⇩s ?σr) |s (vars_term (ω ∙ snd rl)) = ?σr |s (vars_term (ω ∙ snd rl))" 
        proof -
          { fix v :: 'v
            have "vars_rule (ω ∙ (fst rl, snd rl)) - V = vars_rule (ω ∙ (fst rl, snd rl))" using varempty' unfolding funas_defs 
              by (auto simp add: rule_pt.fst_eqvt disjoint_iff vars_rule_def)
            then have "V ∩ vars_term (ω ∙ snd rl) = {}"
              by (metis Un_Int_eq(4) inf_bot_right inf_left_commute rule_pt.snd_eqvt varempty' vars_rule_def)
            then have "(?θ ∪⇩s ?σr) |s (vars_term (ω ∙ snd rl)) = ?σr |s (vars_term (ω ∙ snd rl))"
              by (smt (verit, best) Int_iff disjoint_iff inf.absorb_iff2 sub_θ subst_ext subst_union.simps)
          } then show ?thesis by fastforce
        qed
        have subeq:"subst_rule σr (ω ∙ (fst rl, snd rl)) = subst_rule σ (fst rl, snd rl)" 
          unfolding subst_rule_def subst_list_def using pc' pc rule_pt.fst_eqvt by simp
        have sub_eq1:"subst_term_multiset (δ ∘⇩s ?θ1) (S - {#u#}) = f 0 - {#s#}"
        proof -  
          have "vars_term_set (set_mset (subst_term_multiset δ (S - {#u#}))) ⊆ ?V" using vars_subSu by auto
          hence subm_eq:"subst_term_multiset (δ ∘⇩s ?θ1) (S - {#u#}) = subst_term_multiset (δ ∘⇩s (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr)) (S - {#u#})" using reseqδ 
            by (metis (no_types, opaque_lifting) restrict_subst subst_term_multiset_compose subst_term_multiset_rest_domain)
          hence "... = subst_term_multiset (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr) (S - {#u#})" using δ by auto
          have *:"subst_domain ?θ ⊆ V" by fact
          have **:"subst_domain ?σr ∩ vars_term_set (set_mset (S - {#u#})) = {}" unfolding vars_term_set_def set_mset_def           
            by (smt (verit, ccfv_threshold) "1.prems"(6) SUP_le_iff count_greater_zero_iff disjoint_iff 
                in_diffD inempty le_supE mem_Collect_eq subsetD vars_term_set_def)
          from subst_union_term_multiset_reduction[of ?θ ?σr S]
          have ***:"subst_term_multiset (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr) S = f 0" 
            by (metis Ts θsv f0 le_supE restrict_subst subst_term_multiset_rest_domain varsθ)
          from subst_union_term_multiset_reduction[OF inter_empty **]
          have "subst_term_multiset (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr) (S - {#u#}) = subst_term_multiset ?θ (S - {#u#})" by (metis inter_empty sub_comm)
          also have "... = subst_term_multiset ?θ S - subst_term_multiset ?θ {#u#}" 
            by (simp add: image_mset_Diff subst_term_multiset_def uS')
          also have "... = subst_term_multiset (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr) S - subst_term_multiset (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr) {#u#}"
            by (metis calculation image_mset_Diff mset_subset_eq_single subst_term_multiset_def uS')
          also have "... = f 0 - subst_term_multiset (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr) {#u#}" using *** by auto
          also have "... = f 0 - {#s#}" unfolding subst_term_multiset_def
            by (metis (no_types, lifting) 1(7) SUP_le_iff θsv coincidence_lemma' 
                image_mset_add_mset image_mset_empty le_supE uS' us1 vars_term_set_def)
          finally show ?thesis using δ subm_eq by auto
        qed
        have sub_eq2:"{#replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ)#} = subst_term_multiset (δ ∘⇩s ?θ1) {#replace_at u p (snd (ω ∙ rl))#}" 
        proof -
          have "(snd rl) ⋅ σ = snd (ω ∙ rl) ⋅ σr" using subeq by (simp add: pc')
          have "{#replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ)#} = {#replace_at s p ((snd (ω ∙ rl)) ⋅ σr)#}" using σrdef pc  pc' by auto 
          also have "... = {#replace_at (u ⋅ θ) p ((snd (ω ∙ rl)) ⋅ σr)#}" using us1 by auto
          also have "... = {#replace_at (u ⋅ θ) p ((snd (ω ∙ rl)) ⋅ (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr))#}" using θsv θvarr vuV varsθ uS'  in_subst_restrict 
            by (simp add: vars_defs(2), smt (verit, ccfv_SIG) Un_Int_eq(2) eval_same_vars in_mono in_subst_restrict rule_pt.snd_eqvt) 
          also have "... = {#replace_at (u ⋅ (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr)) p ((snd (ω ∙ rl)) ⋅ (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr))#}" using θsv θvarr vuV varsθ uS' 
            by (smt (verit, best) Int_absorb1 UN_I Un_upper1 rule_pt.fst_eqvt in_subst_restrict 
                le_supE rule_pt.snd_eqvt subsetD term_subst_eq_conv uS' varsθ vars_rule_def vars_defs(2) vars_term_set_def)
          also have "... = {#replace_at u p (snd (ω ∙ rl)) ⋅ (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr)#}" by (simp add: ctxt_of_pos_term_subst p)
          also have "... = {#replace_at u p (snd (ω ∙ rl)) ⋅ (δ ∘⇩s (?θ ∪⇩s ?σr))#}" using δ by auto
          also have "... = {#replace_at u p (snd (ω ∙ rl)) ⋅ (δ ∘⇩s ?θ1)#}" using vars_subS unfolding vars_term_set_def subst_term_multiset_def 
            using coincidence_lemma' by fastforce
          finally show ?thesis unfolding subst_term_multiset_def by auto
        qed
        have f1S:"subst_term_multiset ?θ1 ?S = f 1"
        proof -
          have "subst_term_multiset ?θ1 ?S = subst_term_multiset (δ ∘⇩s ?θ1) ((S - {#u#}) + {#replace_at u p (snd (ω ∙ rl))#})"
            using subst_term_multiset_compose by blast
          also have "... = subst_term_multiset (δ ∘⇩s ?θ1) (S - {#u#}) + subst_term_multiset (δ ∘⇩s ?θ1) {#replace_at u p (snd (ω ∙ rl))#} "(is "_ = ?A + ?B")
            unfolding subst_term_multiset_def using subst_term_multiset_union by auto
          also have "... = (T - {#s#}) + ?B" using sub_eq1 f0 by auto
          also have "... = (T - {#s#}) + {#replace_at s p ((snd rl) ⋅ σ)#}" using sub_eq2 by auto
          ultimately show ?thesis using f1 T' by auto
        qed
        have "∃δ' θ' S'. multiset_narrowing_derivation_num ?S S' δ' (n - 1) ∧ subst_term_multiset θ' S' = f n ∧ normal_subst R θ' ∧
         (δ' ∘⇩s θ') |s ?V = ?θ1 |s ?V"
        proof (rule IH1[of "n - 1"  ?f "f 1" "f n" ?θ1 ?S ?V], goal_cases)
          case 1
          then show ?case using False by force
        next
          case 2
          then show ?case by force
        next
          case 3
          then show ?case using False by auto
        next
          case (4 i)
          then show ?case using rel_chain' by auto
        next
          case 5
          then show ?case using normθ1 by blast
        next
          case 6
          have "f 1 = subst_term_multiset ?θ1 ?S" using f1S by auto
          then show ?case by blast
        next
          case 7
          then show ?case using varSV subθ1 by blast
        next
          case 8
          then show ?case using relstar by auto
        next
          case 9
          then show ?case by (meson 1(9) finite_Diff finite_UnI mgu_finite_range_vars mgu_uv)
        qed 
        then obtain δ' θ' S' where condn2:"multiset_narrowing_derivation_num ?S S' δ' (n - 1)" and subθ':"subst_term_multiset θ' S' = f n"
          and normθ':"normal_subst R θ'" and sub_rel:"(δ' ∘⇩s θ') |s ?V = ?θ1 |s ?V" by auto
        from n0_multiset_narrowing_derivation_num have n1:"n = 1 ⟹ S' = ?S ∧ δ' = Var" 
          using False using condn2 by (metis diff_self_eq_0)
        from condn2 obtain g τ where "(?S,  S') ∈ (multiset_narrowing_step')^^(n - 1)" and g0:"g 0 = ?S" and gnm1:"g (n - 1) = S'"
          and gcond_chain:"∀i < n - 1. ((g i), (g (Suc i)), (τ i)) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step" and compδ':"if n = 1 then δ' = Var else δ' = compose (map (λi. (τ i)) [0 ..< (n - 1)])"
          using False n1 unfolding multiset_narrowing_derivation_num_def by auto
        let ?g = "λi. if i = 0 then S else g (i - 1)"
        let ?τ = "λi. if i = 0 then δ else τ (i - 1)"
        have "δ' = compose (map ?τ [1..< n])"
          by (smt (verit) Suc_pred add_cancel_left_left add_diff_cancel_left' bot_nat_0.not_eq_extremum compδ' 
              compose_simps(1) diff_Suc_eq_diff_pred length_upt list.simps(8) map_equality_iff not_less_eq nth_upt plus_1_eq_Suc upt_0)
        hence δδ'comp:"δ ∘⇩s δ' = compose (map ?τ [0..< n])" using False upt_conv_Cons by fastforce
        have condn:"multiset_narrowing_derivation_num S S' (δ ∘⇩s δ') n" 
        proof -
          have "(S, S') ∈ multiset_narrowing_step' ^^ n" using condn1 condn2 n1 False 
            by (metis (no_types, lifting) One_nat_def Suc_pred bot_nat_0.not_eq_extremum 
                multiset_narrowing_derivation_num_def relpow_1 relpow_Suc_I2)
          moreover have "(∃f. f 0 = S ∧ f n = S' ∧ (∃τ. (∀i<n. (f i, f (Suc i), τ i) ∈ multiset_narrowing_step) ∧
            δ ∘⇩s δ' = compose (map τ [0..<n])))" 
            by (rule exI[of _ ?g], insert δδ'comp False One_nat_def gnm1) (smt (verit, ccfv_SIG) Suc_pred gcond_chain 
                bot_nat_0.not_eq_extremum diff_Suc_1 g0 less_nat_zero_code nar not_less_eq)
          ultimately show ?thesis 
            by (simp add: multiset_narrowing_derivation_num_def False local.wf)
        qed
        show ?thesis
        proof(rule exI[of _ "δ ∘⇩s δ'"], rule exI[of _ θ'], rule exI[of _ S'], intro conjI, goal_cases)
          case 1
          then show ?case using condn by auto
        next
          case 2
          then show ?case using 1(3) subθ' by blast
        next
          case 3
          then show ?case using normθ' by auto
        next
          case 4
          then show ?case 
            by (metis Un_upper1 r_subst_compose reseqθ sub_rel subst_monoid_mult.mult_assoc sup.orderE)
        qed
      qed
    qed
  qed
  then show ?thesis using multiset_narrowing_deriv_implication by blast
qed
  
lemma lifting_lemma_for_multiset_narrowing_for_equational_terms:
  fixes V::"('v::infinite) set" and S::"('f, 'v)term multiset" and T::"('f, 'v)term multiset"
  assumes "normal_subst R θ"
    and "wf_equational_term_mset S"
    and "T = subst_term_multiset θ S"
    and "vars_term_set (set_mset S) ∪ subst_domain θ ⊆ V"
    and mrsteps:"(T,  T') ∈ (multiset_reduction_step)⇧*"
    and fv:"finite V"
  shows "∃σ θ' S'. multiset_narrowing_derivation S S' σ ∧ T' = subst_term_multiset θ' S' ∧ wf_equational_term_mset S' ∧
      normal_subst R θ' ∧ (σ ∘⇩s θ') |s V = θ |s V" 
proof -
  from mrsteps obtain f n where f0:"f 0 = T" and fn:"f n = T'" and rel_chain:"∀i < n. (f i,  f (Suc i)) ∈ multiset_reduction_step"
